source_policy: Source PNGs copied unchanged. Runtime crops and alpha isolation reuse the v19 loader. Original short-shaft attack/death candidates are not active; corrected wide attack sources supply thrust and sweep. Only five distinct key poses per commander; full reaction and per-action cycles remain future art work.

cross_spear.identity_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW high resolution production sprite sheet, transparent background, of a Sengoku Japanese enemy commander in the detailed hand-painted arcade style of the reference. Preserve realistic anatomy, sharp facial detail, clean armor edges and footwear, and believable solid two-handed grips. Character wears blue-gray cloth and black lamellar armor with brass trim, simple kabuto helmet, sandals and white leg wraps. Weapon: a straight long wooden yari shaft with a narrow symmetric cross-shaped jumonji spearhead; absolutely NOT a curved naginata. Exactly SIX separated FULL-BODY figures on a regular THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid in a square canvas, each within its own cell with generous transparent gutters; no overlap, no crop, the entire shaft and blade fit. All face RIGHT (screen-right), consistent head size and body scale. Cells in reading order: 1 idle ready guard, 2 walking with LEFT leg forward, 3 walking with RIGHT leg forward, 4 full forward spear thrust with blade to the RIGHT, 5 wide diagonal spear sweep follow-through pointing RIGHT, 6 lying defeated on ground with weapon beside body. Every upright body has identical height. No ground shadows, no ground plane, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no frames, no glow, no attack effects. This is a finished clean game asset, not a sketch or tiny thumbnail. Match the reference rendering style but use the requested new weapon, identity and poses. Use as much output resolution as possible.
cross_spear.corrected_attacks_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production transparent game character attack asset. Use the supplied sheet as the exact commander identity, armor, colors and painting style reference. Extract and REDRAW TWO separate full-body attack figures on a very wide landscape canvas in TWO EQUAL columns, a single row, generous empty transparent space between them. All face RIGHT. LEFT figure: fully extended horizontal two-handed spear THRUST. RIGHT figure: wide diagonal two-handed spear SWEEP follow-through. The commander wields a long jumonji cross spear with straight symmetric cross-shaped steel head. CRITICAL: the shaft must remain the SAME PHYSICAL LENGTH as in the reference's top-row idle figures. Never shorten it into a knife. In both poses show a substantial rear shaft extending 0.6 torso widths BEHIND the rear hand, and a long forward shaft extending at least a full torso width BEYOND the front hand before the steel head. Grip with two hands spaced naturally. Render FULL shaft and blade, fully inside each cell, no cropping or perspective foreshortening, no overlap between figures. Use a taller centered body inside a spacious wide cell; do not shrink the weapon to fit. Identical head sizes between the two figures, readable legs and feet, finely detailed crisp painterly outlines. No other poses, no grid, no labels, no floor, no shadow, no effects. ACTUAL alpha transparent background. Preserve the reference commander's armor and face.
